import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(req, ev, pol, expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol))
    got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got==expected,(got,expected)
    assert (req,ev,pol)==before
    assert list(got)==['status','value','sources','unknowns']

pol={'required_conditions':['recipe'],'require_verified':False}
req={'claim':'c','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}
check(req,[{'source':'zero','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}],pol,{'status':'supported','value':0,'sources':['zero'],'unknowns':[]})
check(req,[{'source':'none','claim':'c','value':None,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}],pol,{'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['none'],'unknowns':[]})
check(req,[{'source':'uncal','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}},{'source':'cal','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'},'calibration':0}],pol,{'status':'supported','value':7,'sources':['cal','uncal'],'unknowns':[]})
check(req,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'},'supersedes':'old'},{'source':'bad','claim':'c','value':3,'conditions':{'recipe':'X'},'supersedes':'new'}],pol,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check(req,[{'source':'self','claim':'c','value':4,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'},'supersedes':['self']}],pol,{'status':'supported','value':4,'sources':['self'],'unknowns':[]})
caller_ev=[{'source':'caller','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}]
check(req,caller_ev,pol,{'status':'supported','value':9,'sources':['caller'],'unknowns':[]})
print('extended checks passed')

import json
from work import evaluate
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
for result in report:
 assert set(result)==set(schema['required'])
 assert result['status'] in schema['properties']['status']['enum']
 assert all(isinstance(x,str) for x in result['sources']+result['unknowns'])
print('report and schema checks passed')
